label: Main gallery room
futureModelNotes: This file is the first data-backed room footprint baseline. The current room remains the same square/rectangular gallery used before this pack.
The editor map and runtime gallery should eventually read the same room footprint so larger, L-shaped, alcove, corridor, or archive-room layouts do not drift apart.
Future non-rectangular rooms should add an explicit boundary model instead of moving display walls outside the current square shell casually.
